items.title: InCred Capital acquires Quintessentially India for uninclosed amount
items.subject: InCred Capital
items.why: InCred, a KKR portfolio company, is buying InCred Capital in India or ANZ: the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the KKR deal team covering InCred: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: Brookfield and KKR in talks for majority stake in Eyewa at $700M valuation
items.subject: Eyewa
items.why: KKR is reported to be moving on Eyewa ($700M): a buy-side tech DD is being scoped now.
items.call: Call the KKR deal team today and offer to scope the buy-side tech DD before advisers are set.

items.title: Arvind Mathur Appointed Managing Director, Digital, Asia Pacific at EQT Group
items.subject: Arvind Mathur
items.why: A senior move at EQT in Asia: a relationship to open before their first deal needs an adviser.
items.call: Send a note this week and ask for 20 minutes; bring the APAC software view.

items.title: Diamondback Energy and KKR to acquire 70% of Deep Blue for approximately $2.1bn
items.subject: Diamondback Energy
items.why: KKR has agreed to buy Diamondback Energy ($2.1bn): buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the KKR deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: Sempra closes sale of 45% of Sempra Infrastructure to KKR, taking $4.56 billion in cash up front
items.subject: Sempra
items.why: KKR has completed Sempra ($4.56 billion): the value-creation window opens.
items.call: Pitch the KKR portfolio team on tech roadmap, platform consolidation and R&D productivity.

items.title: RWE and KKR commit $16 billion to the UK's Vanguard offshore wind farms
items.subject: RWE
items.why: KKR is backing RWE ($16 billion): confirmatory DD is likely done.
items.call: Offer the KKR team an AI-readiness or scale-up diagnostic as the follow-on.

items.title: OpenAI Acquires Odessia, the AI Travel Agent From Sonder’s Co-Founder
items.subject: OpenAI
items.why: A portfolio company, a Sequoia Capital portfolio company, is buying OpenAI ($6 million): the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the Sequoia Capital deal team covering A portfolio company: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.
